title: Chapter 1058 - 11 Conditions Of The Eye Of Myriad Laws (Seeking Monthly Tickets)
content:
Chapter 1058 - 11 Conditions Of The Eye Of Myriad Laws (Seeking Monthly Tickets)

Chapter 1058: Chapter 11 Conditions of the Eye of Myriad Laws (Seeking Monthly Tickets)

Within the immense pupil of the Eye of Myriad Laws, countless Martial Tao cultivation pathways rooted in life and death extended and spread rapidly.

The force driving the life-and-death Martial Tao to stretch and spread in various directions is the power of time.

As the foundation of the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion, the Eye of Myriad Laws can observe the "futures" of each evolution pathway, located across multiple timelines.

Although it cannot encompass all timelines, it is more than sufficient to judge the potential of an evolution pathway.

A new evolution pathway, especially one without an ultimate existence—who dares to predict how far it can eventually go?

No matter how experienced a powerful individual might be, without personally cultivating a path, any judgment is mere speculation.

The Eye of Myriad Laws dares, because it can glimpse the potential of a pathway through the futures of countless timelines.

"This evolution pathway barely has the potential to step into the Chaos Realm level, but I vaguely feel..."

The Eye of Myriad Laws continued observing the many futures of the life-and-death Martial Tao. In a small number of timelines, Chaos Realm-level powerhouses emerged.

"Something isn't right. This evolution pathway resembles more of a branch stemming from a main path."

The Eye of Myriad Laws finally confirmed its assumption.

In the Chaos Void, countless vast Void Domains exist. The Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion has cataloged an untold number of evolution pathways, naturally aware that some high-potential paths can give rise to branch evolution pathways.

This doesn't mean that pathways capable of spawning branches are always superior to those that cannot, but the former undoubtedly possess higher potential.

"Interesting. The seller wants to leverage the influence of my Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion to disseminate his evolution pathway?"

The Eye of Myriad Laws contemplated. Having seen and experienced too much, it could discern the essence of most matters at a glance.

"Still, an evolution pathway capable of birthing branches does qualify for such an approach."

The Eye of Myriad Laws nodded slightly. A pathway capable of spawning branches generally holds enough potential to reach the Great Saint level.

"Venerable Master of Myriad Laws, what do you think of this evolution pathway?" The old man carrying a wine gourd tentatively inquired.

He had summoned a projection of the Eye of Myriad Laws precisely because he was uncertain whether the life-and-death Martial Tao was a Dominator-level pathway or a Chaos Realm pathway.

After all, the difference between the two is immense.

"It can be considered a Chaos Realm evolution pathway."

The life-and-death Martial Tao across the countless timelines within the pupil of the Eye of Myriad Laws dissipated.

"A Chaos Realm evolution pathway..."

The old man nodded. This aligned with his own intuition.

"I'll let him know..."

Just as the old man carrying the wine gourd was about to reply to Lin Yuan,

the Eye of Myriad Laws, condensed from the vortex of the void, did not dissipate. Instead, it spoke: "I want to meet the seller in person."

"You wish to meet the seller in person, Venerable Master?"

The old man froze. The Eye of Myriad Laws was the true controller of the Ten Thousand Paths Tower. Typically, a projection of the Eye was only summoned to assess uncertain evolution pathways.

Meeting sellers in person? Extremely rare.

Given the exalted status of the Eye of Myriad Laws, it usually disdained personal encounters with sellers.

"Yes."

The old man's thoughts raced, and he quickly nodded.

...

Isolated space.

Lin Yuan stood quietly on a platform of black stone, waiting for the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion's response.

"The credibility of the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion is beyond question; they won't take my evolution pathway without settling accounts," Lin Yuan thought to himself.

In truth, even if the Pavilion were to act unscrupulously, Lin Yuan wouldn't mind. After all, his purpose in coming here was to disseminate the branch pathway of the Martial Arts Evolution Road.

If the Pavilion secretly seized the life-and-death Martial Tao evolution pathway to propagate it, it would actually serve Lin Yuan's intentions.

Nonetheless, the chances of that happening were slim. Across countless Cosmic Eras, the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion had adhered strictly to fair trade principles. Otherwise, it wouldn't have wielded such massive influence.

Relying solely on the strength of its powerhouses? At most, that could instill fear and intimidation.

But the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion commanded the reverence of countless lives. Even Xuanhuang and the Moyu Tower Master hadn't uncovered any "dark secrets," reinforcing its reliability.

...

As Lin Yuan waited silently,

the world suddenly shifted. Lin Yuan was transported directly to another dimensional space.

"Where is this?"

Lin Yuan's expression changed as mysterious runes floated in the surrounding void, rotating slowly. Here, he felt entirely severed from the outside world, even his connection to his true form had been forcibly weakened to some extent.

"Do not be alarmed."

A voice emanated.

Lin Yuan looked over, only to see an old man carrying a wine gourd gazing at him.

"The Pavilion Master of the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion?"

Lin Yuan recognized the old man. Among the most untouchable powerhouses of the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent, this figure was listed.

"And that?"

Lin Yuan turned his gaze to the old man's side, where a phantom vortex hovered, containing a colossal golden eye that was scrutinizing him.

"The Eye of Myriad Laws!"

Lin Yuan's heart jolted. What little was known externally about this ultimate controller of the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion was minimal, though both Xuanhuang and the Moyu Tower Master were fully aware and had specifically left warnings.

"It seems you recognize me?"

The Eye of Myriad Laws regarded Lin Yuan, its tone calm.

"I have seen the Eye of Myriad Laws."

Lin Yuan slightly bowed.

Even Xuanhuang and the Moyu Tower Master would bow respectfully when facing the Eye of Myriad Laws. Naturally, Lin Yuan wouldn't dare act presumptuously.

"Indeed, an evolution pathway capable of creating branches must come from no insignificant origins. It's only natural you'd know of me."

The Eye of Myriad Laws continued gazing at Lin Yuan, speaking to itself.

Its fame might be slightly unfamiliar to Path Splitting Realm and Dominator-level powerhouses, but to those at the Chaos Realm level, Chaos Great Saints, and Absolute Great Saints...
